denext/exhaustive-switch: This switch over `status` misses "done"
  at lint-exhaustive-switch.ts:5:3

    4 | export function label(status: Status): string {
  > 5 |   switch (status) {
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    6 |     case "idle":

  `status` is a union this file declares, and no `case` handles "done". Without a `default`, those values fall through the switch silently.

  Fix: Add a `case` for "done". To have the compiler catch the next missing case, end the switch with
  default:
    return assertNever(status); // import { assertNever } from "denext/result"
